categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Kaibao Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of modern traditional Chinese medicines. The company focuses on three main product lines: respiratory system products represented by Tanreqing injection/capsules, cardiovascular products represented by Qishen capsules, and digestive system products represented by Sulfur proning series. It also operates subsidiaries involved in pharmaceutical sales, equity investment, and health technology development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as fingerprint spectrum detection for quality control of traditional Chinese medicine injections, digital extraction workshops, online drug production monitoring systems, and full-process quality traceability systems. It emphasizes GMP compliance, intelligent manufacturing, and green factory standards to ensure high-quality and safe pharmaceutical production. R&D is supported by collaborations with academic institutions and the establishment of innovation drug research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Shanghai Kaibao serves primarily public medical institutions across China, with products included in the national basic medical insurance drug catalog. Its key customers include hospitals and healthcare providers in respiratory, cardiovascular, and digestive disease treatment sectors. The company’s products are recognized in clinical guidelines and are used in major epidemic prevention and treatment programs.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates nationwide in China, with significant sales coverage in key regions including North China, Central China, East China, West China, and South China. It has established sales teams and marketing networks across provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the central government.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Kaibao operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the pharmaceutical supply chain, focusing on drug manufacturing and direct sales to medical institutions. It also engages in upstream activities through equity investments in pharmaceutical raw material production and related biotech enterprises to optimize its industrial chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in modern traditional Chinese medicine, focusing on core product secondary development, new drug research, and expanding indications. It emphasizes integration of industry, academia, and research, and accelerates clinical trials for pipeline products. Strategic R&D also targets health technology and big health market expansion, supported by government grants and intellectual property protection.
categories.revenue_model: Shanghai Kaibao generates revenue mainly through product sales of pharmaceutical drugs, including injections, capsules, and tablets. It also earns income from licensing, government subsidies, and investment returns. The sales model includes direct sales, regional agency distribution, and participation in centralized drug procurement programs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading modern traditional Chinese medicine enterprise with unique patented products such as Tanreqing injection, recognized as a national protected variety. It holds a strong competitive position in respiratory and cardiovascular therapeutic areas, supported by clinical evidence and inclusion in national medical insurance catalogs. Competitors include other domestic pharmaceutical companies specializing in traditional Chinese medicine and modern biopharmaceuticals.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, Shanghai Kaibao achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.59 billion, representing a 42.47% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 327.87 million, up 71.84%. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, with total assets of RMB 4.58 billion and equity of RMB 4.03 billion at year-end. R&D investment increased significantly to RMB 95.87 million, accounting for 6.01% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Kaibao emphasizes its unique patented products with proven clinical efficacy and safety, especially its flagship Tanreqing injection used in major epidemic responses and included in multiple clinical guidelines. The company leverages advanced manufacturing technologies, stringent quality control, and professional academic marketing to differentiate its products. Its integration of innovation, quality, and strong brand recognition provides customers with reliable, effective traditional Chinese medicine solutions.
